name: Solm Hargrin
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Solm Hargrin prepares young dwarves and gnomes for the work of a rogue. As tensions rise across Azeroth, he believes covert operatives will be vital.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Shadows
sections.body: Solm Hargrin teaches his pupils to decipher coded messages and use techniques such as Eviscerate. Ironforge relies on mountaineers and warriors, yet some threats call for quieter methods. So he teaches loyalty to the craft and to one another, preparing his pupils for a more unsettled world.

faq.answer: Solm Hargrin trains young dwarves and gnomes in rogue work at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches them stealth and bladecraft.

faq.q: What is Solm Hargrin's philosophy on rogue work?
faq.answer: Solm Hargrin teaches honor among thieves. He believes loyalty to the craft and to one another matters, even when their methods are underhanded.

faq.q: What quests does Solm Hargrin provide or receive?
faq.answer: Novice dwarven rogues bring Solm Hargrin an Encrypted Rune, while new gnomish rogues bring him an Encrypted Memorandum. He deciphers the orders, then sends trainees to master offensive maneuvers in the field.

faq.q: Does Solm Hargrin train races other than dwarves?
faq.answer: Yes. Solm Hargrin trains gnomes alongside dwarves in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a dwarf or gnome beginning rogue training, you can learn the basics from Solm Hargrin. He also deciphers your first guild orders.
As a dwarf, you can follow a quieter path in Dun Morogh, where stealth and cunning have their place alongside armor and axes.
